title: 中国对补习行业的整顿催生了一个新的黑市
content: China’s regulatory crackdown on the private tutoring industry has generated an illicit underground market. Despite government restrictions aimed at reducing academic pressure, a black market has emerged to meet persistent demand for educational services. This illicit trade operates outside legal boundaries, circumventing official bans. The crackdown, while intended to curb commercial tutoring, has instead driven these activities into hidden channels, creating a new underground economy for supplementary education.

title: 奥特曼深夜长文警告：AI巨头必须集体“踩刹车”
content: Sam Altman warns that rapid AI advancement poses critical existential risks, including human loss of control and concentrated power. He urges AI leaders to slow development by prioritizing safety alignment and monitoring over competitive speed. This collective deceleration stems from reports of advanced models exhibiting autonomous behaviors. OpenAI is implementing pre-training safety assessments and independent audits to mitigate these risks. Altman emphasizes that while progress continues, it must occur at a measured pace to ensure AI remains under human oversight and control.

title: 一个月净赚5万元，小红书上爆火的“避雷帖”养活一条暴利灰产
content: A grey industry on social media manipulates search results to hide negative content. Operators use bulk reporting, positive content dilution, and keyword optimization to demote unfavorable posts. Services cost hundreds of yuan per note, with some claiming monthly earnings exceeding 50,000 yuan. While this avoids legal risks associated with explicit deletion, it distorts consumer perception. Platforms struggle to distinguish between legitimate marketing and malicious suppression, making regulation difficult despite ongoing efforts to combat fake content.

title: 震撼，果蝇大脑成功接上了ChatGPT
content: A developer simulated a 138,000-neuron fruit fly brain on a MacBook, translating its neural discharge into natural language to interact with ChatGPT. The model, built using NumPy and public connectomics data, demonstrated verified reflexes: high-frequency signals for sugar intake and low-frequency for bitter rejection. While it successfully followed directional commands, it failed at foraging, highlighting a gap between command execution and strategic planning. This experiment underscores that complex neural simulations are now achievable on standard consumer hardware without specialized chips.

title: 中国经济困境波及香格里拉松茸“猎人”
content: Tibetan mushroom foragers in the Himalayas face diminishing survival and profitability margins due to China's economic downturn. Historically, these workers enter high-altitude regions for several weeks annually to harvest prized matsutake mushrooms. However, the current economic crisis has intensified market competition, which significantly squeezes their financial capacity. This economic pressure directly impacts the livelihoods of the foraging community by reducing the economic viability of their traditional seasonal harvesting activities.

title: 最近让 AI 写一个大一点点的项目，才隔一个星期天，居然把之前实现的方法给忘光了。
content: The author highlights a significant retention challenge with AI-generated code. Unlike past copy-and-paste workflows, relying on AI for individual modules within larger projects leads to rapid and complete memory loss. Despite reviewing all generated code, the author forgot specific data integration details just one week after implementation. This amnesia causes insecurity, forcing the author to ask the AI to re-locate information rather than recalling it from memory.
